title: Iterable Review (2026)
intro: Iterable is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Iterable is an AI-assisted customer engagement platform for cross-channel orchestration (email, SMS, push, in-app, and related channels) used by mid-market and enterprise B2C brands. Pricing is custom / contact sales (commonly MAU and messaging volume) — no public list-price floor on iterable.com (2026-08-17). Confirm live proposal. Do not invent custom-quote dollars. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Iterable when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement is the primary job and you are shortlisting Braze peers.
verdict: Choose Iterable when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement is the primary job and you are shortlisting Braze peers. Compare Braze for alternate enterprise engagement, Marketo for B2B MAP, Customer.io for mid-market event messaging, and Klaviyo for ecommerce owned channels. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
